description.narrative:
This funding would support a collaborative initiative designed to strengthen youth leadership and intercultural exchange across regions. The resources would be used to facilitate a two-part program: one segment hosted in Netherlands, Europe, focusing on exchange and dialogue between global north and global south young change makers. and another in East Africa in a bootcamp format for the learning and training between young community builders and changemakers.
The grant would cover essential costs suchas travel, accommodation, facilitation, and materials for workshops and field visits. It would also support the development of tools and resources that help participants engage more effectively in community-based initiatives, while fostering safe and inclusive spaces for learning andreflection.
Ultimately, the goal is to equip young people with practical skills, broaden their perspectives, and build lasting connections that contribute to more resilient and inclusive communities in the face of climatechange.
